notes.title: Hotfix patch (v1.1.2)
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Gamers[/h3]

This is no April Fools joke, just a hotfix patch focusing on a couple of small things:

[list]
[*] Fixed conflicting behaviour between Voomba and player (if one of them cleans first, the other got stuck)
[*] Hide the book tracker when the day ends
[*] Fix NPC navigation under peculiar circumstances (everyone used to walk into the void for seemingly no reason)
[*] Fixed furniture placing when it's right next to another item but off-screen/on walls (it used to allow this, but shouldn't have)
[*] Adjustments to NPC navigation to avoid getting stuck on corners
[/list]

On a second note, we have reached a whooping [b]100 reviews[/b] on Steam. 

Thank you so much for your support.

Kind Regards
[h3]Bit66[/h3]

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Mega Patch (Shop expansion & New Characters)
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Gamers[/h2]

[h1]Book Bound 1.1 Mega Patch is out now[/h1]

It's been an amazing couple of weeks since launch. Thank you so much for playing Book Bound until now. I have been reading all your feedback and took on as much as possible to shape Book Bound into a great game. So here we are. 

This update contains lots of changes that have been requested and I think they are pretty cool.

[list]
[*] New cast of characters that you can chat with. Each with its own unique backstory and dialogue.
[*] Benches are now reserved for the new cast. You will find characters of the new cast on benches.
[*] Added a new Upgrades Menu which allows you to unlock a bunch of things (mostly things further on this list)
[*] Added shop expansions (left and right; total size of the shop can be 3x the original now)
[*] Added custom wall segments to create your own room (unlocks with the first shop expansion)
[*] Added Multi-save support allows you to start new bookshops without losing the old ones
[*] Added Self-checkout item (unlocked via upgrades menu); Customers will automatically pay and leave. You can still checkout customers by standing behind the cash register
[*] Added Voomba station (unlocked via upgrades menu); Spawns a little robot that cleans the shop for you (Voomba station contains more upgrades)
[*] Added Direction sign (unlocked via upgrades menu); When customers look for books and they stand near a sign, they will find the book automatically (no need to help)
[*] Added Storage (unlocked via upgrades menu); Lets you store lots of books (12 in total)
[*] Added a new Build menu filter for "functional" items that have abilities beyond decoration
[*] Added character name creation when starting a new shop
[*] Balanced the amount of rubbish generated
[*] Improved NPC behaviours (more adjustments to make sure they don't get stuck)
[*] Removed NPC conversation when the shop is closed (they didn’t add anything to the game)
[*] Removed zombie NPC’s (for now)
[*] Dialogue progression with Stefan has been reset so see the new version
[/list]

The cast:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332825/c7937531af4fda1b1ee0170ce0d19b9437f5dc16.png[/img]

I hope you will enjoy this update.

Thanks

[h2]Bit66[/h2]

notes.title: Hotfix patch (v1.0.2)
notes.content:
Hey all, today, I am publishing the second hotfix for Book Bound with an emphasis on the NPCs (and books). 
[list]
[*] NPCs can be "clicked through" if they can't be interacted with (easier to click on shelves/books/help-needing customers behind this NPC)
[*] NPCs avoid walking into the void. They stay in the same spot if they can't find a path
[*] Fixed NPC dropping books at the end of the day 
[*] Fixed NPC buying books after loading the game
[*] Fixed NPC lingering in the shop after closing (re-enforce their leaving behaviour)
[*] Fixed NPC "skipping queue" after loading the game
[/list]
Hopefully, this brings more stability to the game for you to enjoy.

Thank you so much for your continued support.

notes.title: Hotfix patch (v1.0.1)
notes.content:
Hey all, I have published the first hotfix for Book Bound. It's small but contains some important fixes:
[list]
[*]Added a check to make sure customers leave when the day ends
[*]Made sure that genre backgrounds don't get disabled again
[*]Building furniture uses the correct hitbox
[*]Workstation hitbox fixed
[*]Fixed wrong highlighting when moving furniture using a controller
[*]Added the ability to "point to shelf" from inside the shelf menu too (this seems to be causing a lot of confusion)

[*]Attempt to fix picking up books around the cash register (darn you invisible Stefan)
Please let me know if this is still an issue after the update.
[/list]

Thank you so much for your continued support.

notes.title: Book Bound Demo out now!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey gamers[/h3]

I am so excited to announce the release of the [b]demo of Book Bound[/b].

With this demo you can finally start decorating your own cozy bookshop and chat with Stefan!

[list]
[*]Decorate and run your bookshop
[*]Invite people in the area
[*]Help customers find books
[*]Keep your shop tidy
[*]Unlock more books in genres 
[*]Sell books at least once to continue your genre progression
[/list]

I wanted this demo to include as much possible but there are 2 limitations:

[list]
[*]No save
[*]Limited books and genres. Available genres are Romance and Fantasy (Scifi, Non fiction and Thriller are locked in the demo).
[/list]

I am all ears for any feedback you may have.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332825/6d5feab97070129acbfdc3192c602e998112fea3.png[/img]

[h2]
Happy decorating
Bit66
[/h2]
